description:
In this industry-first Prop Firm Roundtable, we bring together six of the biggest names in the trading space - JadeCap, Trader Kane, Okala, Trader Yush, Dhesi Trades and Vince Koehn. This episode dives into consistency rules, copy trading, risk frameworks, seven-figure payout runs, major drawdowns, the psychology behind elite performance, and the real mindset it takes to survive and thrive in prop firm trading long term. We hope you enjoy this roundtable!
